verdict.rationale: telli publishes a REST API reference with per-endpoint pages (schedule-call, import-phone-number), bearer-token auth docs, and a live OpenAPI spec that can be imported into Postman or handed to coding agents. That gives a structured reference that can be made runnable with external tools. Nothing shows an in-docs interactive playground or runnable examples, so execution relies on extra tooling. Missing for 10: an interactive "try it" console in the docs, documented runnable request/response examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
